title: Film appearances: Minsky's, Rock Rock Rock and Carib Gold
summary: Two-shot movie roles, LaVern Baker not acknowledging the band, and an Ethel Waters film.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: I made a couple other pictures. I had a two-shot
picture in The Night They Raided Minsky's.
I remember seeing you in there.
And I had a big band. And it was all reduced down just to the girl Bill and I.
END T551
Huh. How did that come about?
It was editing. You know, it called for a date, but it was editing that resulted in the two-shot. And then I was in a two-shot with --
(Side B.)
Luverne Baker.
Oh, the two shot I had with Luverne Baker and Rock Rock Rock picture.
And Allen Freed, you said.
Allen Freed in the rock and roll era, the Teenagers featured in that film. Well, all those groups --
BEGIN T552
What were you telling me, that Hall was doing during the filming, she never --
She didn't look at one of us or speak, and I mean --
That must have made you feel good.
(Laughter.)
Wow, you know, we remarked about it. Jimmy Wright's band was the band, and we did most of the rock and roll dates during the '50s.
But she never looked back once,
never said a word.
She didn't say a word to us.
And what was that other film you said you made with Ethel Waters?

Oh, "CARIB GOLD" (phonetic)? Well, I played in the New York show on that. It didn't -- it didn't have any message. It didn't have it. Some good scenery, what's the -- what's the Chinese photographer, Wong?
James Wong Howe?
James Wong Howe? Yes, he was the photographer.
But it was nothing for Ethel Waters, I guess --
No, it didn't mean anything.
I never even -- I'm not even aware of it. You know, I consider myself somewhat of a movie buff. But this was after "Member of the Wedding" or before?
Oh, it had to be after --
After, sure.
It was in the '50s, early '50s.
